name: trace
title: Trace
description: shadcn/ui's base-nova trace, fixed: Keeps pending and description text at 4.5:1 contrast, marks a failed line in greys, by weight, not red, and leaves its fold's title untinted, and a fold's title and content at its rows' size (text-sm); a line's description is its result, smaller, at the line's end, so results line up in a column; with reduced motion a fold opens and its chevron turns at once. Running titles pause while out of view with use-shimmer-pause.
